turns.text: Hello, I'd like to move my flight tomorrow to a later departure, please.
Happy to help. Can I have your booking code and last name first?
Thank you, Ms. Chen. I see SK210 to London tomorrow at 08:10 in Economy. Which flight would you like instead?
SK214 has seats available at 380 dollars. Since your booking is over 24 hours old, there's a 75 dollar change fee on Economy. Your fare is 410, so SK214 is 30 dollars cheaper.
Okay. Is that thirty dollars refunded, or does it just go away?
The fare difference doesn't come back as a refund, and I can't offer a credit on it either, so the cost to you is the 75 dollar fee. Would you like me to go ahead?
Yes, that's fine, please go ahead.
Done. You're now on SK214 tomorrow at 23:55, with the 75 dollar fee applied. Is there anything else I can help with?
You're welcome. To sum up, I moved you from SK210 to SK214 tomorrow at 23:55 for a 75 dollar fee.
